scope: all new full matched ProxyWar matrices
work_unit: one complete candidate-versus-exact-parent matched pair per pod
prohibited_shortcuts: do not shorten decision horizon solely for throughput
do not mix seeds, images, or rosters within a pair
do not accept partial transfer as evidence
do not begin a later wave until its artifact hashes and pair audits pass
release_rule: release every pod after its evidence has been fetched and independently verified
